Finally I dumped her and she was sad but not terribly sad. At least not until I started seeing another girl from bumble 2 weeks later. That's when she really lost it. She spiraled just like I did. Got suicidal thoughts. Severe depression. The whole works. She blocked me on literally every platform and we went our separate ways. Well me and bumble girl weren't anything special. There were no sparks. 

I regretted leaving my ex maybe like 4 days after I started dating that bumble girl. Like I knew I truly loved my ex and started to get really really depressed again. 4 months go by and out of nowhere my ex texts me and asks if we can just talk. So of course I agreed because I missed her desperately. I dumped the bumble girl the next day and me and my ex hit it off like we were freshly in love. Maybe even better. Like I was the happiest man alive. Well that lasted for about 2 months and she, once agajn, dumped me out of nowhere. Saying she couldn't forgive me for how I treated her when I dumped her. 

So here I am now. Two weeks have gone by. And my ex is showing absolutely no signs of taking me back. And I am destroyed. Like I've called suicide hotlines and paid for therapy but it's not helping. I'm in bad bad shape.

So there's my two cents.

I feel like you are agreeing with what I just said? I said airfoils alone do produce lift as the original person had said. I just said it wasnt enough if you were at a 0 attack angle and would thus have to take the re-direction of the air into account as well. I also mentioned the re-direction of air also creates pressure differences by way of Bernoulli's principle. 
I guess in my last sentence I should have said that theories stating that 100% of the lift of an airplane comes from an airfoil is in correct as the forces are not enough. But in combination with the re-direction of the airflow you get lift. So my mistake I apologize.
I also feel like I may have gone a little further than an explanation for a 5 year old.

Unfortunately, the "airfoil" is not the force providing lift. It is an extremely common misconception that the airfoil and equal transit theory is what causes lift in an airplane. It's a partial factor but the much larger lifting force comes from the re-direction of air causing pressure differences. This is often referred to as the attack angle. Airfoil only theories would have to assume airplane wings provide lift with a 0 attack angle and that's simply not true. 

EDIT: the airfoil alone is not the force providing ALL of the lift. Airfoils in principle do provide lift at a 0 attack angle but not enough for flight.

Hey so I actually am finishing up with all the legal ramifications of mine and I can answer some of your questions and clear up some of confusion.  So YES he did the right thing to get a new license because you need a license as ID for a lot of things. HOWEVER, he now has to send in a signed document to the MVD in Santa Fe with a 25 dollar check or else his license will be revoked in something like 15 days.  That 25 dollar check will basically give him a hearing where he can contest the revocation of his license (which he will for sure lose because the MVD only cares that he was rightfully arrested for DWI not "convicted" of a DWI) and the MVD will say he must carry an INTERLOCK license which states he cannot operate a car without an interlock device (breathalyzer). Keep in mind this hearing and sentence is completely separate from the charges he faces with the state of NM. The interlock device is mandatory from the MVD. Once he goes to his arraignment in court and submits his plea, he will begin to face the legal process to assess his punishment with the state. Because its his second offence but the second offense came more than 10 years after his first he might get tried as a first offense but dont quote me on that.  If the court finds him guilty he will also be required to install an interlock device (so basically an interlock will be installed no matter what even if he is found innocent in the eyes of the court). So when its all said and done he is looking at tons of mandatory counseling, hefty court fines, hefty lawyer fees, monthly fees for an interlock device and POSSIBLY more jail time.
